help_topics.name: authentication
help_topics.summary: Store GitLab access tokens with pm credentials; never pass secret values in command text.

help_topics.name: operation-inventory
help_topics.summary: The GitLab source-lock ledger retains 1,752 cited REST identities: 582 direct reads, four ETL streams, and 147 approval-gated reverse-ETL actions are executable through closed contracts.

help_topics.name: known-limits
help_topics.summary: The remaining 1,019 source identities are discoverable named-foundation blocked outcomes; 2,306 source-contract gap entries overlap by operation and are not a row denominator.
